headline: Anthropic adds reporting tools showing enterprise customers the value of their token spend
body: Anthropic has new reporting tools for enterprise customers. Managers can view a team's work, what the team produced and what it cost. Anthropic says it won't use this data for model training by default.
note: For teams paying for tokens, return on investment is the concern, and TechCrunch says these reports are an attempt to show it.

evidence.text: Anthropic has focused on getting enterprise users to stick around and Wednesday announced a new suite of reporting tools designed to give those customers a more granular understanding of the value they get from their token spend.
Using internal analytics and employee surveys, managers can view a team’s work over a given date range, what the team produced, how much it cost, and where its workflows broke down.
Anthropic says it won’t use this data for model training by default.
This is a clear attempt to demonstrate the return on investment of Anthropic’s tools and to show customers how to improve it — a major concern among large customers.
